name: Daniel
label: Frustrated by recurring app bug
who: I use Spotify on my phone and sometimes on my computer, and I mostly want music to play without problems. A bug has kept coming back for me across reinstalls and updates, and I have tried most of the usual fixes.
value_for_money: Paying for a service that does not work feels bad. One user says they cancelled over the unresolved bug, another says they are still paying a subscription while it persists, and another says paying for Premium fixed their problem.
loyalty: Stays while hoping the bug gets fixed and while some fixes work for others. Would leave if the bug stays unresolved, with one user saying they plan to move to YouTube Music.
pain_points: Recurring bug survives reinstalls and cache clears
Support sends generic steps and does not acknowledge bugs
Updates do not fix it, and it sometimes starts after one
App drains phone battery so it has to be paused
likes: Some fixes work for others, like updating or reinstalling
Support replies quickly, even if the steps do not help
Beta program sometimes has a stable fix
Premium fixed the problem for one user
reasons_to_stay: They keep using Spotify while they wait for the recurring bug to be fixed, and they try the fixes that have worked for others. Several posts say that once the bug is gone they would keep the service, so the bug is the main thing holding them back.
tone: Frustrated and informal, with lowercase text, exclamation points and a few jokes.
